title: fix(effect-sdk): export keyless to a custom endpoint from the Cloudflare and flushable presets

summaries.body:
<!-- maple-pr-review c2357752-d28d-47e6-af6f-5e6b9ce5b2ba 0 -->
## Maple review

🟢 **Confidence 10/10** · safe to merge
The endpoint-scoped keyless policy is pinned by tests for both presets and the shared helper; nothing else in the flush path moves.
<sub>no findings · tests covered · risk medium</sub>

Keyless export from the Cloudflare and flushable presets now no-ops only against Maple's hosted ingest, and sends without `Authorization` to any other endpoint. The three open errors in the changed files are browser-side throws in code this diff does not touch, so none is addressed.

- `buildResolved` no-ops keyless only when the endpoint is Maple's hosted ingest
- Cloudflare and flushable presets switch to `disable-at-maple-ingest`
- No-op notice now also names `MAPLE_ENDPOINT`

### Before merge

- [ ] **Manual** · Update `apps/landing/src/content/docs/sdks/effect-server.md` and `skills/maple-effect-style/SKILL.md`: both still say `MapleFlush.make` no-ops without a key. <!-- ms:manual:update-apps-landing-src-content-docs-sdks-effect-server-md-and-skills-m-bd6d947f -->

After this merges, Maple checks whether they stop.

<details><summary>What was checked</summary>

- `isMapleIngestEndpoint` compares `URL.origin`, so trailing slash, uppercase host and `:443` still no-op (`browser-session/src/platform/region.ts:82`)
- Both presets read `MAPLE_ENDPOINT` through `resolveResourceFromEnv`, so the new notice text is accurate
- `buildResolved` has three call sites, none exported from the package barrels; the union change breaks no public type

</details>

## Maple review

🟢 **Confidence 10/10** · safe to merge
The new keyless rule is pinned by three test files across both presets; hosted-ingest URLs with a path prefix correctly fall through to send.
<sub>no findings · tests covered · risk medium</sub>

The Cloudflare and `MapleFlush.make` presets now disable export only when keyless against Maple's hosted ingest and export keyless everywhere else, matching `Maple.layer`. Safe to merge; none of the three open error issues is addressed — the landing `telemetry.js` and maple-web `flushable.js` throws are client-side faults the diff does not touch.

- `buildResolved` no-ops keyless export only when the endpoint is Maple's hosted ingest
- Cloudflare `make` and `MapleFlush.make` switch to `keyless: "disable-at-maple-ingest"`
- The no-op notice now suggests `MAPLE_ENDPOINT` as the keyless alternative

<details><summary>What was checked</summary>

- `isMapleIngestEndpoint` normalizes case, trailing slashes and default ports; a path or another host returns false (`packages/browser-session/src/platform/region.ts:82`)
- Keyless endpoint resolution reaches a local collector: `MAPLE_ENDPOINT` beats `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT` (`packages/effect-sdk/src/server/config.ts:15`)
- `buildResolved` and `flush-core` are not re-exported from any package entrypoint, so the narrowed `keyless` union breaks no public type
